prompt: I have this idea for an app that helps remote workers find coworking-friendly cafes near them. It would show real-time seat availability, WiFi speed, noise level, and power outlet info. But I'm not sure if this is really a problem worth solving or if Google Maps already handles it.

assertions.text: Determines the user's starting point and current confidence in the idea
Asks structured validation questions about the problem, audience, and market
Evaluates idea viability with specific criteria (problem severity, market size, competition)
Identifies specific risks (Google Maps competition, data collection challenge, real-time accuracy)
Helps refine the concept beyond the initial description
Produces a structured Big Idea deliverable file in the project directory
Updates or references the dependency tracking system
